name: search_code
description: Search the project source with the most deterministic engine that fits the question. engine="ast-grep": structural AST patterns with metavariables ($NAME, $$$ARGS) — use this whenever you are looking for a code *shape* rather than text, in a language it supports (JS/TS, Python, Rust, Go, C/C++, Java and more). It does NOT support Zig, so it cannot be used on this project's own src/ — use rg there. engine="semcode": semantic queries over an indexed C/C++/Rust tree (needs .semcode.db); also not Zig. engine="rg": ripgrep regex, the fallback for Zig and for plain text. Prefer a precise regex anchored on syntax (e.g. "fn name\\(") over a bare identifier, and read the file before acting on a match. Input: {"engine": "rg" | "ast-grep" | "semcode", "query": "...", "path": "."}. Returns {"ok": bool, "code": int, "stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}.
